source_notes: Re-verified 2026-06: Ilo export terminal remains shelved. No project advancement found in 2024-2026 web research; last documented bilateral activity was March 2022. The terminal depended on Bolivian gas via the (also-dormant) Bolivia-Peru Gas Pipeline, and Bolivia's gas-export base collapsed in 2024 (exports to Argentina ended 18 Sep 2024; production declining sharply per Wood Mackenzie/Gas Outlook), making a new export liquefaction project at Ilo highly unlikely to revive. Status determination is GEM-inferred (Substatus 'inferred 2 y'); these URLs corroborate continued dormancy, they are not a formal cancellation announcement.
